method: Each model was asked the same 5 questions about Superstate USTB in a fresh session with no conversation context, instructed to use no tools (verified: 0 tool calls in each run), answering from its own knowledge only. One run per model. Models: Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5 (via Claude Code subagents). A Claude Fable 5.2 run was attempted and failed for account-credit reasons, so it is not included. Ground truth: Reckon's live reads (on-chain, issuer page, SEC via Telegraph, GLEIF).

result: Across 15 answers, the models gave 0 exact answers and 1 partly-right answer. They did not hallucinate numbers: nearly every answer was an honest "can't know without live data". Reckon answers all five from live sources with receipts. The gap is not that models are wrong; it's that they can't know, and Reckon can.
limits: One run per model, Claude models only, tools off (a model with web search would do better on Q3-Q5); the question set and truth were written by us; the truth comes from Reckon's own reads and the issuer's page.
